opening.argument: The presentation leads with “Earn 25 BTC Over & Over Again!” while seeking participants “ready to invest 0.005 btc in this program,” pairing a small stated investment with repeated, extraordinary earnings. It describes “a 2 x 2 matrix with multiple stages,” team building, uplines, and requirements to add participants, then ties advancement to further payment: “Whoever completes Stage 2 Level 2 will buy 2 positions with the team link.” Interested viewers are directed to “PM me in my facebook messenger or comment 'info' if you are interested.” Although it states there is no monthly fee or administrative charge, the structure centers on recruitment, tiered stages, and additional position purchases. The available evidence does not establish that any transfer occurred, that returns were delivered, or how the program operated in practice.
